description: Configures ESLint v9 flat config and neostandard for JavaScript and TypeScript projects, including migrating from legacy `.eslintrc*` files or the `standard` package. Used to set up or fix linting with `eslint.config.js` or `eslint.config.mjs`, troubleshoot lint errors, configure neostandard rules, migrate from `.eslintrc` to flat config, or integrate linting into CI pipelines and pre-commit hooks.
